title: Medicine. Do defaults save lives?
abstract:
Default options can lead to striking differences in preferences, with significant economic impact. The
 authors
 of this Policy Forum use natural and experimental data to examine the impact of simple policy defaults on the decision to become an organ donor, finding large effects that significantly increase donation rates.

claims.text: Default options can lead to striking differences in preferences.
Simple policy defaults significantly increase organ donation rates.
